name: c-trace-15
title: CSV import
description: A CSV import that counts up while it runs, with rejected records, their problems and a download link.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@/components/ui/table" import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle, } from "@/components/ui/trace" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" const ERRORS = [ { row: 12, field: "email", problem: "Missing" }, { row: 87, field: "phone", problem: "Not a phone number" }, { row: 233, field: "email", problem: "Invalid domain" }, ] const TOTAL = 2404 // The last step counts up in its description, and rejected rows are a Table // because they are scanned by row number. export function Pattern() { const [imported, setImported] = React.useState(0) const done = imported >= TOTAL React.useEffect(() => { if (done) return const timer = window.setTimeout( () => setImported((n) => Math.min(n + 143, TOTAL)), 120 ) return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, [imported, done]) return (
Parsed contacts-october.csv 2,418 rows Mapped 8 of 9 columns 1 ignored Rejected 14 invalid rows
{/* A borderless Card is the outer frame; the table sits flush in it. */} Row Field Problem {ERRORS.map((error) => ( {error.row} {error.field} {error.problem} ))}
{done ? "Imported" : "Importing"} {TOTAL.toLocaleString("en-US")}{" "} contacts {/* Only the end result is announced; every tick would flood a screen reader with numbers. */} {done ? "in 2.1s" : `${imported.toLocaleString("en-US")} of ${TOTAL.toLocaleString("en-US")}`}

{done ? `Imported ${TOTAL} contacts` : ""}

) }
